
# Release Notes: Version 6.7.2
**Release Date:** April 10, 2026

---

## 🚀 New Features
 - Feature 1: SASL support for Finnish and Forgotten War nationalities (BCFK, CPVA, KPA, OUNC, SK). Use the existing U.S. Army S? for Korea.
 - Feature 2: LOS enabled bdLFT1 and added options for different beach slopes.
 
---

## 🛠 Bug Fixes
 - Fix 1: British Sherman IIA(a) missing front inferior turret armor symbol.
 - Fix 2: Japanese 9-0 leader fixed.
 - Fix 3: Fixed several Null bugs causing VASL to crash.
 - Fix 4: Fixed bugs when adding overlays via boardpicker.
 - Fix 5: Fixed Board data bug causing VASL to crash.
 - Fix 6: Fixed OBA Window bug causing VASL to crash.
 - Fix 7: Fixed ROF Die bugs causing crash.  
 - Fix 8: Removed assault fire underscore from British AE and E half squads.
 - Fix 9: Display Bulgarian 70* INF Gun in Counter Palette properly.
 - Fix 10: Added missing Italian dice image.
 - Fix 11: Added missing Finnish S? counter.
 - Fix 12: LOS bugs for Hillocks and Marsh to Swamp transform fixed.
 - Fix 13: Range display for linked (CTRL-ALT-L) counters fixed.
 - Fix 14: Base CVP value for Italian squads and all HS set correctly.
 - Fix 15: Slaughter at Ponyri Sapper Squads/Halfsquads broken sides.
 - Fix 16: Game Updater functionality restored. 
 - Fix 17: Ammo Depletion indicator bug fixed. 
 - Fix 18: LOS bugs with Bocage and Cliffs fixed.
 - Fix 19: Remove "(f)" notation from Axis Minor SW mortars not present on physical counters.
---

## 📈 Improvements
 - Improvement 1: Created "Gutted Building Wall" terrain types to support VotG LOS.
 - Improvement 2: Added missing Axis Minor "German" MMG, HMG and PSK counters.
 - Improvement 3: Selecting Preserve Board Elevation when adding Overlays in Boardpicker now works better with LOS and changes are stored in the .vsav file and will persist across sessions.
 - Improvement 4: Draggable Overlays (under the Orchard Button on the Toolbar) now work with LOS (EXC: Deluxe Draggable Overlays).
 - Improvement 5: LOS support for bdHT (Hatten In Flames), bdVotG (Valor of the Guards) added.
 - Improvement 6: Minor graphical changes to the Japanese HMG/.50 cal HMG counters.
 - Improvement 7: HIP Fortification now displays bd and location info for Fortification and Unit when asking to reveal.
 - Improvement 8: Corrected counter palette label for IP Carrier Mk IIA (was incorrectly labeled "IIS).

---

## ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
- **Minimum Version Required:** Built with VASSAL 3.7.20
